mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at a clear and pleasant 71 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School with a lovely waxing gibbous moon.

The City of Verona has announced that the Police Department is looking for a part-time records clerk to provide coverage on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and alternating Fridays. They are also seeking lateral transfer police officers for a variety of roles including K9 and bike patrol.

There is plenty to do in town, with Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia both taking place today. Tomorrow, you can look forward to the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and even more trivia options.
Looking at the weekly report, on August 19th, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash at North Main Street and Bering Drive, resulting in citations for both drivers involved.
Today's flavor of the day is the popular OREO Cookie Cheesecake, and you can grab a scoop before the store closes at 10 PM tonight.
